sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Panthers: Week 7 Initial Injury Report
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers returned to the practice field Wednesday as they prepare for Sunday’s Week 7 NFC South matchup against the Carolina Panthers at Bank of America Stadium. Tampa Bay’s initial injury report featured five players who did not participate, including wide receiver Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot), offensive tackle Luke Goedeke (calf), linebacker Christian Rozeboom […]
